title: DexPortal v2.0: The Nexus Update
excerpt: Introducing Command Palette, Timeline, and 3D interactivity. A complete overhaul of the portal experience.
content:
## Introduction

Welcome to **DexPortal v2.0**. This update brings a massive overhaul to the user interface and user experience.

### New Features

- **Command Palette**: Press `Ctrl+K` to navigate anywhere.
- **Timeline**: A visual history of my journey.
- **3D Interactivity**: Easter eggs and hidden interactions.

```typescript
console.log("Hello, DexPortal v2.0!");
```

I hope you enjoy exploring the new site!
author: Dexpie

title: New Reader Engine for DexKomik
excerpt: We've completely rebuilt the manga reading experience with smoother scrolling and better image loading.
content:
## Faster, Smoother, Better.

The new **Reader Engine** is here. We've optimized the image loading pipeline to ensure near-instant page turns.

### Benchmarks

| Version | Load Time | FPS |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| v1.0 | 1.2s | 45 |
| v2.0 | **0.3s** | **60** |

Check it out now on the main app!
author: Dexpie

title: DexPDF Now Supports Cloud Storage
excerpt: Sync your PDFs with Google Drive and Dropbox seamlessly. Access your documents from anywhere.
content:
## Cloud Sync is Here

No more losing your documents. **DexPDF** now integrates with:

1. Google Drive
2. Dropbox
3. OneDrive

> "This feature is a game changer for my workflow." - *Beta Tester*

Get started by linking your account in the settings.
author: Dexpie
